paragraphs: Conveniently located within Riccobene Family Dentistry in Knightdale, teens and adults enjoy modern orthodontic care in our advanced facility.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
When you need specialized dental care, Riccobene is here for you. Our team has specific expertise in orthodontic care to personalize your dental treatment.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our Knightdale office sits in Widewaters Commons, just off US-64 and near I-540, making visits simple for patients across eastern Wake County. We’re close to Knightdale Station Park, Widewaters Shopping Center, and neighborhoods like Cheswick and Langston Ridge.

Brush And Floss Orthodontics in Knightdale provides comprehensive dental services in a modern, family-friendly space. Whether you’re coming from Raleigh, Wendell, or Zebulon, our office offers convenient, compassionate care designed around your schedule.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Knightdale office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

Orthodontics can correct a vast array of dental conditions, such as crowding, protruding/poorly spaced teeth, overbites, underbites and other misalignments. At Riccobene, we can help you treat them all.

Yes - both teens and adults can get Invisalign® at our Knightdale location. Schedule an initial consultation to see whether Invisalign® is the best option for your orthodontic needs by giving us a call.
Scheduling a consultation is as easy as giving us a call - you can reach us at (919) 266-6999. You can also book an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule as soon as possible!

Yes - whether it’s a concern with broken equipment, unexpected pain related to your orthodontic care, or urgent treatment needed for a new issue, we make an effort to see all emergency visits same or next day when possible. Give us a call to describe the emergency you’re having and we’ll help find the right care for your needs, as fast as is practicable.

Yes - what age is best for children to get braces will depend on your child and their dental development. We recommend most children getting braces around the time that all their permanent teeth have come in, but depending on what specific circumstances your child encounters earlier intervention may be needed. The easiest way to make sure we’re providing the right treatment for your child at the right time is to book a consultation today!

Invisalign® aligners are offered at our Knightdale, NC orthodontic practice. Other options may be available depending on your specific needs and circumstances - consult with an orthodontist today and we’ll help you sort out your choices.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

The length of orthodontic treatment varies on what specific treatment you’re receiving - from as speedy as a single office visit to an extended treatment plan over weeks or months, orthodontic care is about making sure you receive care that’s effective, lasting and appropriate for your oral health. An orthodontist can help you understand the length of your specific treatment plan before any work is performed.
Yes - Phase I and Phase II orthodontic treatment is available for children at our Knightdale, NC location.

You can see our team here. At Riccobene, we pride ourselves on experienced, qualified staff. We don’t like to brag, but we also don’t think you’ll find a better team of orthodontists, dentists, hygienists and staff anywhere around!

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: Cearena was awesome. Always give great customer service and remembers her clients! My son and I appreciate her!
Cearena was so kind and patient. She also squeezed us in to get two of my kids appointment in one day. Dr Patel was so sweet and thorough. Great experience.

We always have a positive experience at Riccobene Dentistry. Today we were seen by Dr Patel the orthodontist, she was extremely kind and patient with us. Cearena the treatment coordinator was simply excellent. She worked with us despite the tightness of the schedule (we showed up a little late), she patiently explained our options and she had a huge hug for me and my daughter when we seemed a little overwhelmed. I highly recommend this practice. They are definitely all about helping their patients.

My 15yo had his wisdom teeth removed here. Not only did I save money, my son loved everyone who helped us. He was nervous about the shots, but didn't even feel them! His mouth barely hurt afterward & that says a lot about the care he got during the procedure. When a 15yo doesn't complain you know he actually was doing ok. He liked them so much he wants to use them as his regular dentist. Thank you for taking such good care of my kid.

My kids and I have been going to Riccobene ever since we moved here in 2018. We've always been well taken care of. Everyone has been personable and understanding when I have to bring our baby to my appointments. The dental hygienists have always done an awesome job with each of us. The dentist is also thorough with his exam at the end. My kids love going to the dentist. Probably because they know they'll get little toys at the end for being helpful during the appointments.
They were so wonderful! The Dentist and Hygienist were professional and very helpful! They know what they're doing, such an asset to this office!

Had such a great experience at Riccobene. My hygienist was so pleasant and kept me informed of everything she was doing and why. She was very gentle. The dentist was very nice, he has a great beside manner. Would highly recommend.
I am pleased with the dental care that I receive at Riccobene, because of my pleasant visits, I look forward to dental care.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What orthodontic treatments are offered in Knightdale, NC?

Orthodontics can correct a vast array of dental conditions, such as crowding, protruding/poorly spaced teeth, overbites, underbites and other misalignments. At Riccobene, we can help you treat them all.

Can teens and adults get Invisalign® in Knightdale?

Yes - both teens and adults can get Invisalign® at our Knightdale location. Schedule an initial consultation to see whether Invisalign® is the best option for your orthodontic needs by giving us a call.

How do I schedule a complimentary orthodontic consultation in Knightdale?

Scheduling a consultation is as easy as giving us a call - you can reach us at (919) 266-6999. You can also book an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule as soon as possible!

Does the Knightdale office offer emergency orthodontic care?

Yes - whether it’s a concern with broken equipment, unexpected pain related to your orthodontic care, or urgent treatment needed for a new issue, we make an effort to see all emergency visits same or next day when possible. Give us a call to describe the emergency you’re having and we’ll help find the right care for your needs, as fast as is practicable.

Are braces available for children in Knightdale, NC?

Yes - what age is best for children to get braces will depend on your child and their dental development. We recommend most children getting braces around the time that all their permanent teeth have come in, but depending on what specific circumstances your child encounters earlier intervention may be needed. The easiest way to make sure we’re providing the right treatment for your child at the right time is to book a consultation today!

What types of clear aligners are offered, such as Invisalign®?

Invisalign® aligners are offered at our Knightdale, NC orthodontic practice. Other options may be available depending on your specific needs and circumstances - consult with an orthodontist today and we’ll help you sort out your choices.

Does the Knightdale office accept dental insurance or offer payment plans?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

How long does orthodontic treatment typically last in Knightdale?

The length of orthodontic treatment varies on what specific treatment you’re receiving - from as speedy as a single office visit to an extended treatment plan over weeks or months, orthodontic care is about making sure you receive care that’s effective, lasting and appropriate for your oral health. An orthodontist can help you understand the length of your specific treatment plan before any work is performed.

Is early orthodontic treatment (Phase I) available for children in Knightdale?

Yes - Phase I and Phase II orthodontic treatment is available for children at our Knightdale, NC location.

Who are the orthodontists serving the Knightdale office, and what are their qualifications?

You can see our team here. At Riccobene, we pride ourselves on experienced, qualified staff. We don’t like to brag, but we also don’t think you’ll find a better team of orthodontists, dentists, hygienists and staff anywhere around!
